user.title: Sign in to South East Water
user.description: Enter the email address and password you use for my.southeastwater.com.au. The portal will then send you a one-time code.

data_description.username: The email address you sign in to my.southeastwater.com.au with.
data_description.password: Your portal password. It is stored in Home Assistant so re-authentication only needs a new code.

mfa_channel.title: Where should the code be sent?
mfa_channel.description: South East Water requires a one-time code for every new login. Choose how to receive it.

data_description.mfa_channel: The portal sends the code to the email address or mobile number on your account.

mfa_code.title: Enter the one-time code
mfa_code.description: Type the 6-digit code South East Water just sent you.

data_description.mfa_code: Six digits; spaces and dashes are ignored.

history.title: Import history
history.description: Optionally enter the date your digital meter was installed. Everything from that day is imported into long-term statistics in the background after setup; leave it blank to import the last 90 days only. You can always import more later with the sew_water.import_from_date action.

data_description.import_from: First day to import, usually the meter installation date. Must be before today.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {username} has expired. Continue to request a new one-time code.

reauth_password.title: Update password
reauth_password.description: The saved password for {username} was rejected. Enter the current password to continue.

data_description.password: The password you now use for the portal.

reconfigure.title: Sign in again
reconfigure.description: Enter your portal credentials to replace the stored session. The portal will send a new one-time code. The email address must be the one this entry was set up with.

data_description.username: The email address you sign in to my.southeastwater.com.au with.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the South East Water portal.
error.invalid_auth: The email address or password was not accepted.
error.invalid_code: The code was not accepted. Check it and try again.
error.login_unexplained: The portal did not accept the sign-in but gave no reason. Check that these details work at my.southeastwater.com.au, then enable debug logging for the integration, try again and open an issue with the log.
error.no_mfa_channel: The portal did not offer a way to send a code.
error.start_in_future: The date must be before today.
error.unknown: The portal responded unexpectedly. Check the logs for details.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the South East Water portal.
abort.invalid_auth: The portal rejected the session before setup could finish.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Signed in again; the new session is stored.
abort.unknown: The portal responded unexpectedly. Check the logs for details.
abort.wrong_account: The account you signed in to does not match this entry.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between polls. At the default of 1440 the poll runs once a day at 2 AM local time, when the previous day's readings are usually available.

force_import.name: Force import
force_import.description: Poll the portal now instead of waiting for the next scheduled poll.

import_from_date.name: Import from date
import_from_date.description: Import every day from the given date up to yesterday into long-term statistics.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the South East Water portal: {error}

no_entries.message: South East Water is not set up.

portal_busy.message: The South East Water portal is busy and the poll will be retried shortly: {error}

session_expired.message: The portal session has expired; a new one-time code is required.

session_rejected.message: The portal rejected the stored session: {error}

start_in_future.message: The start date must be before today.

unexpected_response.message: Unexpected response from the South East Water portal: {error}

backfill_failed.title: South East Water history import did not finish
backfill_failed.description: Importing water usage from {start} failed: {error}. It will be tried again the next time the integration is loaded, or you can run the sew_water.import_from_date action with start_date {start} yourself.

v1_entry.title: South East Water entry “{title}” needs to be set up again
v1_entry.description: This entry was created by an earlier version of the integration and holds no portal session, so it cannot be migrated. Delete it under Settings → Devices & services → South East Water, then add the integration again and sign in with a one-time code. Your existing water statistics are kept.
